{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is invalid (NaN)
valid_sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = valid_sales_df[
    (valid_sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (valid_sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
